title: Governance — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: WhiteHouse College follows a transparent, accountable, and participatory governance system that supports academic excellence and institutional growth.
Premises of Nidi Secondary School & Indreni Campus

blocks.heading: Transparent & Accountable Management
paras: WhiteHouse College follows a transparent, accountable, and participatory governance system that supports academic excellence and institutional growth. The college is guided by experienced academic leaders, administrators, and governing bodies committed to maintaining high standards in education, research, and student services.

blocks.heading: Guided by Commitment to Excellence
paras: Our governance structure ensures that every decision prioritizes student success, academic quality, and institutional sustainability.

groups.title: Academic Oversight
text: Program quality is monitored through Kathmandu University guidelines, internal reviews, and continuous faculty development initiatives.

groups.title: Participatory Leadership
text: Experienced academic leaders and administrators collaborate with faculty, staff, and student representatives in decision-making.

groups.title: Quality Assurance
text: Regular assessments, accreditation reviews, and performance metrics ensure institutional standards are maintained and improved.

groups.title: Institutional Accountability
text: Transparent reporting, financial oversight, and compliance with regulatory standards demonstrate our commitment to responsible management.

groups.title: Institutional Board
text: Provides strategic oversight and long-term vision for institutional development and sustainability.

groups.title: Academic Council
text: Oversees curriculum development, program quality, and faculty development initiatives.

groups.title: Administrative Leadership
text: Manages daily operations, student services, and institutional support systems.

groups.title: Transparency
text: Open communication about policies, decisions, and performance metrics affecting the college community.

groups.title: Accountability
text: Clear responsibility for outcomes and continuous monitoring of institutional performance.

groups.title: Student-Centered Focus
text: Every policy and decision prioritizes student success, safety, and overall development.

groups.title: Academic Integrity
text: Maintaining high standards in teaching, research, and institutional reputation through ethical practices.

blocks.heading: Questions About Governance?
paras: Contact our administration office for more information about institutional policies and leadership.
